commitResults.messageBody: Make colapsed guide header keyboard accessible

commitResults.messageTitle: Anchor core storage paths to the packaged JAR
commitResults.messageBody:
Resolve preferences, client data and the instance lock from the real JAR
folder so launching from another directory does not select another data
set or bypass the original lock. Keep exploded-class working-directory
behavior and leave diagnostic logging to the dependent S1 change.

Verify packaged startup, restarts, shared locks and persistence failures
in separate JVMs, plus URI encoding and resolver fallback cases.

Refs #259

Distinguish JAR-relative storage from IDE and Gradle development runs
so setup instructions select the intended data folder. Explain symbolic
links, isolated manual checks and the risk of retaining data in build/.
Resolve core storage paths relative to the packaged JAR

commitResults.messageTitle: Make Unicode JAR launch tests portable
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep the Unicode JAR code source while avoiding raw Unicode arguments
that the Windows launcher cannot open. Launch this fixture relatively
from a child folder and transport its expected location as an ASCII URI.

Retain absolute-path launches in the other scenarios and preserve all
storage, lock and CodeSource assertions. Change test code only.
Keep Unicode JAR-home tests portable on Windows

commitResults.messageTitle: Repair support-page links and test references
commitResults.messageBody:
Support pages rely on rewritten source links, the Testing evidence table
expands the document, and the platform matrix names a retired test.

Use explicit published routes, contain the evidence table in a keyboard
accessible scroll region, and describe the permanent Client ID
assertions. Preserve historical run records, checksums and the original
table text.
Repair support links, test matrix and table layout

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep diagnostic logs beside the packaged JAR
commitResults.messageBody:
Early diagnostic logging uses the launch directory even after core
storage paths follow the packaged JAR. A different caller can therefore
receive logs outside the application home.

Resolve the FileHandler path through ApplicationHome and escape literal
percent signs before pattern expansion. Preserve append, rotation,
logging levels and the console fallback.

Add fresh-JVM packaged regressions for caller independence, literal
paths, unavailable logs, concurrent locks and rollover.

Refs #259
Keep early diagnostic logs in the JAR home

commitResults.messageTitle: Report edit usage for extra preamble tokens
commitResults.messageBody:
A mistyped first prefix makes the edit parser blame a valid Client ID.
Check the preamble shape before parsing the ID so extra tokens receive
edit usage, while single invalid IDs retain their existing diagnostics.

Preserve literal unknown prefixes inside field values and cover rejected
edits, unchanged saved state and successful correction in both filtered
and pending views.

Fixes #260

commitResults.messageTitle: Pin the v1.4 release screenshot to its source
commitResults.messageBody:
The historical release page uses a mutable dashboard image that now
shows later Client ID and editing features.

Point the dashboard image at the verified v1.4 source commit and explain
its historical provenance. Keep the current screenshot unchanged.

Refs #265. The current Developer Guide correction belongs to I1.

commitResults.messageTitle: Pin all historical v1.4 release screenshots
commitResults.messageBody:
The filtered-summary and error screenshots still use mutable image
paths, so later releases can change the historical page's evidence.

Pin both remaining images to the verified v1.4 source commit and update
the provenance sentence to cover all three screenshots.

Refs #265. Shared Developer Guide completion remains reserved for I1.
Report edit usage for malformed preambles
Pin the historical v1.4 release screenshot
